newsitem.title: USA: US spot LPGs mixed, Pemex diverts propane cargo.
newsitem.headline: US spot LPGs mixed, Pemex diverts propane cargo.

text.p: U.S. spot liquefied petroleum gas prices were mixed in quiet trade on Wednesday that saw some short covering on normal butane ahead of the close of the month, players said.
Meanwhile, traders reported that Pemex diverted a 35,000-tonne cargo of propane headed for Dow from Algeria. The boat is to arrive in the U.S. Gulf Coast on Friday.
In Mont Belvieu, Texas, spot propane was unchanged at 34.00 cents to 34.25 cents a gallon. Conway, Kansas, material was steady at 35.25/35.50 cents. The high end of both ranges were done.
Normal butane rose about a half cent to 38.25/38.50 cents amid short covering. Conway, Kansas, material however was slightly down.
